title: Compat hints & auto-pin suggestion flow for new open models
creator: Aisha Patel
summary: Clarify requirements and acceptance criteria for a two-part onboarding feature: (1) compat-hint metadata that models submit at ingest and (2) an automated pin-suggestion signal (auto-pin) surfaced to reviewers and runtime.
description: Background: New open-weight submissions frequently omit runtime-level signals we need to choose an appropriate default pin and rollout strategy. Current intake relies on manual notes and ad-hoc engineering probes, which slows catalog ingress and increases risk of runtime regressions. Proposal: define a lightweight, backward-compatible 'compat-hints' metadata contract and an 'auto-pin suggestion' pipeline that combines static hints, runtime profiling results, and a confidence score. The ticket clarifies PM requirements, UX notes for reviewers, and what runtime engineering needs to consume the signals. Goals: faster triage of community submissions, consistent pin defaults, fewer surprise regressions in Hosted/Dedicated/Private, and a clear rollback signal tied to telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Define compat-hints JSON schema (max 6 fields) and examples for common architectures (causal, encoder-decoder, LlaMA-like, MPT-like). Schema is documented in the model intake PRD.

Auto-pin suggestion algorithm is specified: inputs listed (compat-hints, static model metadata, runtime micro-bench results, tokenization checks), scoring formula documented, and expected thresholds for 'suggested-pin' vs 'recommend-manual'.
Design for reviewer UI in Console: suggested pin shown with confidence band, reason summary, and links to profiling artifacts. Mockups in design doc linked.
Runtime contract: pointer to runtime-compatible variant names if pin applied, and fallback mapping described (including automatic fallback to 'small-quantized' if latency SLOs breached).

Defined telemetry events and tagging standard to detect regressions post-onboard (3 events: catalog.onboarded, catalog.pin_applied, runtime.compat_regression) and alert thresholds configured in console-ops playbook.

E2E acceptance test: ingest three synthetic open models (low/medium/high compatibility), run profiling, assert that system suggests pins per thresholds and that suggested pin can be applied in a canary rollout with automatic rollback on regression signals.
Documentation: intake PRD, runtime adapter spec, reviewer UI mockups and a short 'how-to' playbook for solution engineers are uploaded and linked.
Dependencies and owners listed and sign-offs from runtime, infra, and security teams obtained before rollout.
decisions: Compat-hints will be additive and optional: missing hints must not block ingest; auto-pin will fall back to manual review if confidence < 0.6.
Keep schema narrow (compatibility_level, required_seqlen, kv_cache_behavior, quant-friendly: boolean, tokenizer_family, known_incompatibilities list) to balance signal value vs submitter burden.
Auto-pin suggestions are advisory (UI-only) for first two weeks, then gated for automated application for low-risk models after metrics observed.
Telemetry-driven rollback preferred over manual only rollback: if runtime.compat_regression > 0.5% error increase or 20% P99 latency regression in canary, the system will auto-revert the pin mapping.
No hard-coding of variants in catalog; use alias mapping so model owners can update underlying variants without reopening onboarding.
implementation_notes: PM: finalize compat-hints schema and acceptance thresholds (owner: Aisha).
Design: supply reviewer UI mockups and compact reason strings (owner: Priya Malhotra).
Runtime: implement a light-weight probe harness to run micro-bench profiling on ingest variants and emit profiling artifacts (owner: Daniel Kim).
Backend: add scoring service that aggregates hints + profiling and returns suggested_pin, confidence_score, and explainability tokens (owner: Nikhil Rao).
Console: add suggested-pin UI element and action to apply suggestion to a canary rollout (owner: Jordan Lee).
SRE/Alerts: add detection rules and runbook for runtime.compat_regression and pin rollback (owner: Sasha Ivanov).
QA: create E2E test harness with three synthetic models and integrate into CI for catalog ingestion tests (owner: QA team).
